title: Ambient Lighting
description: Assign factory ambient color presets to every driving mode and enable automatic following

screens.name: MAIN
screens.title: Driving-mode ambient lighting
items: Disabled - choose a mode to assign a color

Tap a mode to choose its color. All catalog modes are listed; only those fitted to your car can occur. Unassigned modes leave the lighting unchanged. Following continues in the background while this app is running.

screens.name: COLORS
screens.title: Choose ambient color
items: Colors 1-12 are the car's factory menu slots, not invented color names. To identify one, choose a color in BMW lighting settings with following disabled, then use Assign current vehicle color. Brightness, on/off and dynamic lighting are left unchanged.
